t: What Evolutionary Adaptation Database Is All About
title: What Evolutionary Adaptation Database Is All About
description: Adaptations are traits shaped by selection: giraffe necks, antibiotic resistance, Arctic fox coats. Darwin (1859) proposed natural selection; the modern synthesis added genetics. Evidence standards are strict: show the trait varies, is heritable, and affects fitness — otherwise it's a just-so story. Lenski's E. coli (1988–present) watched bacteria evolve citrate metabolism in real time over 70,000+ generations. This database is the complete adaptation: full records with definitions, key facts, procedures, and runnable demo programs, organized on a teaching ladder from Foundations to Advanced.
definition: Evolutionary Adaptation Database: a complete reference database of full adaptation records.
key_points: What this database holds: full adaptation records, each with definition, key facts, and a runnable demo program.

t: Core Vocabulary of Evolutionary Adaptation Database
title: Core Vocabulary of Evolutionary Adaptation Database
description: Every field has its own language. These are the working terms of Evolutionary Adaptation Database — learn them first and every later record reads faster: natural selection: differential reproduction by trait; fitness: reproductive success; heritability: trait variation passed to offspring; convergent evolution: independent arrival at similar traits.
definition: The working vocabulary of Evolutionary Adaptation Database: the terms practitioners actually use.
key_points: natural selection: differential reproduction by trait
fitness: reproductive success
heritability: trait variation passed to offspring
convergent evolution: independent arrival at similar traits
selective pressure: environmental force favoring traits
genetic drift: random allele frequency change
how_it_works: Read each term and definition twice.
Use three terms in a sentence of your own.
Quiz yourself with the demo program.
Add new terms as you meet them.
